procedural_next_steps: Author clean-room board/piece geometry as project-owned source when execution becomes authorized; do not derive shapes by tracing a third-party chess set.
Select one exact Noto Sans (or equivalent OFL) binary later, record version/SHA-256/license text, and confirm intended embedding/distribution mode.
Keep US Chess facsimiles and historical scoresheet photos out of release media unless a separate permission/fair-use decision is documented.
Select voice/TTS and music/SFX only when production requirements are known; bind exact provider terms and asset IDs before use.
Generate a final upstream manifest mapping every rendered asset byte to creator/license evidence.
Require human commercial-rights signoff; clean-room policy alone does not promote R6.

production_baseline_policy.rationale: Avoid making release depend on provenance recovery for legacy stills, unidentified piece graphics/font, or archival facsimiles.

font_candidate.current_basis: Official Noto documentation states OFL and permits commercial print/digital product use; exact future binary still requires SHA-256, version and bundled license record.

archival_policy.basis: US Chess archive states PDFs are for personal and research use only and permission is required beyond fair use.
